images.clustering: None. Vessels are spread out along the lanes: westbound ships in the northern half (q1/q2) and a loose SE-bound stream in q4 east of the Quoin islands.
images.notes: Clear, glint-free scene. The q4 top-centre greenish hull (~15-20 px, SE-bound) is the only large vessel. Most other hulls are about 8-14 px, so many sit near the medium/large boundary. The q2 lower-left vessel (~280,1094) is moving but its heading is unclear. The q4 bottom-right vessel is cut off at the image edge. Not counted: a q2 speck at (~85,722) with no wake, and the 3 Quoin islets in q4.

images.clustering: None. Westbound vessels sit in a band across the northern third. Eastbound and SE-bound vessels are scattered in q2-q4. Nothing is grouped or holding position.
images.notes: Dark, clear scene with faint green surface slicks/streaks, which were not counted. Large vessels: a red-hulled westbound ship in q2 with a long wake, and a green hull SE-bound in q4. A bright fast-moving target with a broad V wake in q2 (~1400,715) is counted as one medium vessel heading NE, but it could be several boats. A partial vessel at the q1 left edge and the SW-heading q4 vessel (~828,170) have unclear lane direction. The 5 small craft all have wakes. The moving/stationary counts cover large and medium vessels only.

images.clustering: None. Several eastbound ships are strung along the western/central lane (q1 lower-left to q3 top-right). One small stationary hull sits alone in q2 lower-right.
images.notes: Many small cumulus clouds and their shadows are visible across all tiles, well above the 0.76% cloud-mask figure, so I estimate about 15% of the water is hidden. Large vessels: q1 green hull (~128,718), q1 cyan hull (~595,1175), q2 bright westbound (~205,313) and q3 top-right (~1100,140). The stationary medium vessel is at q2 (~1287,887) and has no wake. Not counted: a bright point at the q1 bottom edge (~955,1208), faint streaks in q4 lower-left (~155,835) that may be small-boat wakes, a speck at q4 (~1145,835), and cloud fragments next to the islets.

summary.qualitative: Traffic was moderate and steady: about 11-14 large and medium vessels per image, all three images usable, and little change between images apart from the large/medium split. Almost every vessel was under way with a clear wake, with more eastbound/SE-bound than westbound traffic. No anchorages, queues or groups of stationary ships were seen.
